apps.label: Rusty XR Quest Broker
apps.description: Public sidecar broker proof-of-concept APK for localhost WebSocket samples, optional LSL forwarding, optional OSC UDP egress, and OSC-to-WebSocket drive events. Catalog launches use a no-display service starter; the visible console remains available from the headset launcher.

deviceProfiles.label: Broker smoke test
deviceProfiles.description: Short Quest verification profile for the non-rendering broker proof-of-concept.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker latency WebSocket to LSL
runtimeProfiles.description: Starts the localhost broker endpoint. If a compliant Android liblsl build was supplied at APK build time, latency samples are forwarded as LSL string samples; otherwise they are accepted and logged for API smoke testing.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker latency OSC egress
runtimeProfiles.description: Mirrors accepted broker latency samples to a laptop OSC UDP receiver. Replace the placeholder OSC host before launching from a real catalog.

runtimeProfiles.label: Broker OSC drive ingress
runtimeProfiles.description: Listens for laptop OSC values at /rusty-xr/drive/radius and rebroadcasts accepted values to localhost WebSocket clients as osc_drive JSON events.
